description: We are Sunlit Signal, a team from Pakistan and Uganda. LunaPilot helps plan Moon south pole landings: for Artemis III candidate regions it uses NASA JPL data to compute Sun and Earth elevation, then power and communication scores, a season view and a best-window finder. Our geometry matches NASA JPL Horizons to 0.000 degrees. Live app: https://lunapilot-28tiyt7dwmst4pknnzkqzp.streamlit.app/
